title: Return a small result
summary: Assembly: Return a small result. Change 5 to 7.
introduction: rdi is a register: a tiny storage place in the processor. Linux exit reads its status from rdi.
learningObjectives: Return a small result with Assembly

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Return a small result
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 5
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.text: mov puts 5 in rdi. The exit syscall takes its code from that register.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Exit codes are only 0 to 255; use small values in these lessons.
